responsibility: Provides `rustc_trait_selection`’s diagnostic layer for inference and trait solving by centering reporting on `TypeErrCtxt`, then coordinating two major subsystems: inference error reporting and trait error reporting. The inference side turns type, const, and region inference failures into diagnostics, including missing type-information errors, contextual notes and fix-up suggestions, subtype-relation tracking for ambiguity reporting, and region-error handling that first routes through `NiceRegionError` and its specialized lifetime reporters and utilities for anonymous, named, placeholder, `'static`, `impl Trait`, and trait-vs-impl lifetime mismatches before falling back to generic notes. The trait side reports ambiguous, fulfillment, `on_unimplemented`, overflow, and other obligation failures, deduplicating and prioritizing trait diagnostics while supplying trait-specific explanations and recovery suggestions. Together these files implement the crate’s end-to-end machinery for translating trait-selection and inference failures into structured, actionable compiler diagnostics.
